title: NSE margin basket (Finspot OMS, Margin Basket)
purpose: The margin percentage Finspot charges per NSE scrip for one product basket. First line: 'NSE Margin Basket', the product code (I = MIS, C = CNC, H = CO, M = NRML, B = BO) and the basket name; then one line per NSE equity scrip in the previous business day's market data: symbol, series (from the NSE security master, EQ when not known) and margin percentage = VaR + extreme loss margin from the day's data, never below the firm's minimum. Product, basket name and minimum percentage are firm settings in Connections → Finspot uploads (I, NSEMIS and 20 by default).
source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet Margin Basket (header 'NSE Margin Basket|I|NSEMIS'; NSE symbol, NSE series, margin percentage; delimiter |)
